# OSUI Extensibility

How to add behavior to OutSystems UI patterns beyond what their input parameters expose — without forking the pattern. Four levels: `ExtendedClass` styling, typed `Set<Provider>Configs` / `Set<Provider>Event` Client Actions, direct `OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.<X>API` JavaScript calls, and reusable wrapper Blocks with their own lifecycle.

**Canonical doc:** [`ui-frameworks/outsystems-ui/extensibility.md`](../../../ui-frameworks/outsystems-ui/extensibility.md)

The full content lives in the canonical doc — open it for the complete reference. This wrapper exists so agents that load skills from `.claude/skills/` (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) discover this content via its description, then follow the link.
